verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is that the Ramp CLI is described as open-source and hosted publicly on GitHub (ramp-public/ramp-cli). The core Ramp product (cards, expenses, bill pay, API backend, MCP servers) is documented only as a hosted proprietary service, with an OpenAPI schema but no source. Missing for 10: open source for the core platform or MCP servers, a named open license for any component (even the CLI's license is not stated), and independent confirmation of the CLI's licensing.
